source_review.notes: Checked all 10 structured references against current official W3C, NIST, AWS, Apache Atlas, OpenMetadata, DataHub, Open Policy Agent, and OWASP sources; every final URL returned HTTP 200. Verified DCAT 3 catalog/resource/distribution/service, rights, version and security framing; current catalog/search and policy capabilities; and access-control guidance in their stated scopes. Vendor features are examples, not universal guarantees.

evidence: Checked candidate authorization, metadata projection, ranked-set, exposure-lag, source/index reconciliation, disjoint visibility and coverage notation plus balanced GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Symbols distinguish resource, field, subject, purpose, time, authoritative state and served derivatives.

evidence: Executed policy-filtered-catalog-search and matched two ordered visible IDs, no secret resource and only allowed projected fields.
Recomputed 24/30 metadata readiness as 80% and max(10 seconds, 4, 12, 3, 20 minutes) exposure lag as 20 minutes.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The search fixture filters before scoring/counting and the exercises use the authorized denominator and end-to-end lag.

evidence: Expanded R = Rank({Project: match and allow}) and confirmed authorization/projection precede every response-derived operation.
Verified J_v subset I_v is the exposure-safety condition and J_v minus I_v identifies stale or unauthorized served documents.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The model does not infer data access from discovery or a proven lag when any propagation state is unknown.

evidence: Reviewed exact-name, direct-ID, total, facet, suggestion, timing, pagination, graph, profile, sample, embedding, generation, cache, tenant and policy-outage leakage.
Reviewed stale ownership/classification, late updates, rebuild resurrection, partial provisioning/revocation, permanent grants, derivatives, holds, deletion and client caches.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Adversarial coverage spans discovery, inference, authorization, propagation, use and lifecycle boundaries.

evidence: Traced stable identity, field classification, authorize-before-derived-output, separate discovery/data decisions, purpose binding, propagation reconciliation, grant expiry and derivative governance through examples and answers.
invariant_checking.notes: No metadata, catalog grant, ticket state, masked sample, source update or zero result is described as broader proof than it provides.

evidence: Reviewed safety from closure of every response operation over current allowed projected candidates and liveness from stable identity, sufficient metadata, ownership/policy and eventual workflow availability.
proof_review.notes: Timing, inference, compromise, missing metadata/ownership and unavailable services explicitly bound the claims.

evidence: Safety and liveness statements and their arguments are explicitly labeled; counterconditions immediately limit both.
The executable is labeled an illustrative policy invariant rather than production authorization or relevance proof.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Formal claims, proof sketches, deterministic behavior, current documentation and policy conclusions remain distinct.

evidence: Current standards and product behaviors are attributed to named official sources.
Search receipts, reconciliation, canaries, effective grants and lifecycle outcomes are layer-specific evidence; qualified roles own policy and obligation decisions.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: The chapter separates documented capability, measured behavior, authorization evidence and assurance conclusion.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed end to end: stable catalog semantics, metadata sensitivity, authorize-before-rank/projection, derived search surfaces, profiles/previews, access lifecycle, governed derivatives, propagation, reconciliation and authorized relevance form a coherent control model.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed the discovery control record, falsifiable claim, policy-filtered search, progressive disclosure, request/provision/revoke workflow, index tombstones, canaries, metrics, ten examples and merger recovery for operational usability.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed progression from one-page model through prerequisites, retrieval/projection, leakage surfaces, lifecycle, notation, proofs, executable, 12 trade-offs, 24 misconceptions, ten examples, connections and five exercises with complete answers. Connections retrieve DE-076/081-089 and API-017/034 and prepare DE-091.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
